rows.en: Celica: "Rayfon! It really is you!"
Rayfon: "Yes... It's been a while, Celica.
You've grown even prettier while I was away.
And you've cut your hair... It really suits you."
Celica: "Oh, Rayfon!"
Rayfon: "Oh? Is that you over there...?
It seems you made it out safely."
Touya: "Yeah."
Kasumi: "The person you met in your dream, Touya..."
Touya: "Yeah. This is him."
Rayfon: "I managed to get out soon afterward myself.
I stopped by the palace to make some preparations, and before I knew it,
all sorts of things were happening here.
I wish I'd been ready a little sooner,
but regenerating Aidion took time."
Celica: "So that really was Aidion.
I'd only ever seen it resting
in the Chamber of Sealing..."
Rayfon: "That's right. In the distant past,
it flew to Earth... the world those people over there
came from."
Kasumi: "Huh? Then... is it an alien machine?"
Arthur: "But how did it end up here in Agarthia?"
Rayfon: "It came to fight that enormous object you said you saw,
Vorlia. The excess energy from their battle
was enough to destroy Earth.
So Aidion and the other two, Sivarius
and Coolmarishin, changed the nature of that energy
and used it to create Agarthia.
In other words, Earth and Agarthia are two sides of the same coin.
They are one and yet different, while still
affecting each other."
Celica: "Y-You mean..."
Rayfon: "This may be hard to believe all at once,
but it's all true. Though everything I know
comes from Grauzer, who's inside me."
Touya: "Grauzer?"
Rayfon: "When that explosion happened three years ago,
Grauzer, who had become a transcendent consciousness,
saved me from what should have been my death.
I didn't want to die. I wanted to live.
When I came to, Grauzer and I had merged.
We'd taken refuge in that space using his power."
Celica: "Was this Grauzer the one who
arrived aboard Aidion?"
Rayfon: "Yes. I don't fully understand it myself,
but there's a universe beyond Earth, and another universe
far beyond that. Apparently, that's where they came from.
Their home was called 'Lin Karma.'
They seem to share a common ancestry with the humans of our solar system,
but apparently that isn't certain.
What we do know is that the humans of Lin Karma
and those of our solar system look remarkably alike,
so that theory probably isn't wrong.
Back on Lin Karma, Grauzer was the scientist who created Aidion,
Sivarius and Coolmarishin, the three Ultra-Offensive Shell Units
called 'Shinkaio.'"
Touya: "...I'm completely lost..."
Celica: "So Agarthia was created as a result
of the battle with Vorlia, by aliens from
somewhere called Lin Karma. And one of them,
Grauzer, is living as a consciousness inside
Rayfon's body... Is that right?"
Rayfon: "Yes. I think the other two will arrive
soon, so we'll explain everything in detail then."
Touya: "Hey, there's still more...?"
Maid: "Excuse me. Lord Valga Solma
and Lady Rishuna Milsh have arrived."
Rest: "Good. Show them in."
Touya: "...Hm? Hey! You're that old guy!"
Valga: "Oh, so you managed to meet up safely?"
Touya: "So you really are aliens
from this Lin Karma place too?"
Valga: "Indeed. But unlike Rishuna here
and Grauzer, this is my original body."
Touya: "Your original body?"
Rishuna: "This body originally belongs to a girl named Mana Elua.
You might say I am 'borrowing' it.
Grauzer's situation seems to be different..."
Rayfon: "Grauzer trusts me."
Touya: "Huh... Hey, wait a second...
You guys came here and created Agarthia, right?
Then just how old are you, old man?"
Valga: "It's rude to ask an old man his age.
My age and my measurements are a secret."
Touya: "You're a real joker, old man. Anyway,
you're here to beat the ≪Ze=Ode≫
too, right?"
Rishuna: "Vorlia, not the ≪Ze=Ode≫."
Arthur: "Yes, that's it.
What exactly is this Vorlia?
You mentioned it earlier..."
Rayfon: "Rishuna, would you explain?"
Rishuna: "Yes. Understood.
Rishuna: "...To put it simply, Vorlia
is a 'vessel.'
What goes inside it is the 'consciousness' of intelligent life.
Vorlia was created to collect
that 'consciousness.'
As such, Vorlia has no will of its own.
It merely carries out the command it was given:
'Collect consciousness.'"
Celica: "W-Wait, isn't that the same 'plan'
Dr. Debish was talking about?"
Rishuna: "Yes. The ≪Ze=Ode≫ Spirit Mech he pilots
is merely one of Vorlia's peripheral organs..."
Touya: "I see... But who built that thing and sent it here,
and what for?"
Rishuna: "We know that people from another world
sent it, but as to their purpose...
There is more than one Vorlia, though.
They appear to have been sent to various universes."
Touya: "There are more of those things?!"
Rishuna: "There have been no reports of multiple Vorlia
in a single galaxy.
However, the existence of more than one has been confirmed.
Our own Lin Karma was all but destroyed by Vorlia.
Only the three of us escaped."
Touya: "This is getting pretty damn serious.
So if that Vorlia comes back, everyone in this world
will disappear?"
Valga: "Yes. What Vorlia wants is information
possessed by intelligent life in outer space.
It seems to have no interest in resources or technology.
When it comes to a world, only the living things vanish.
Vorlia is summoned when the Rayblade you pilot
and the other five ≪Ze=Ode≫ Spirit Mechs
come together.
Now that the path has opened again, the only way to stop it
is to destroy Vorlia itself."
Touya: "...And that's why you showed up?
Why didn't you do anything before...?"
Rayfon: "We... Or rather, the consciousnesses inside Rishuna and me,
along with Valga, somehow managed to seal Vorlia.
Then, with our strength exhausted, we went to sleep."
Rishuna: "With a reaction from Vorlia as our trigger to awaken."
Valga: "I awoke when Goderius was revived,
but Grauzer was between dimensions,
so I couldn't reach him.
Rishuna and I had no choice but to attack
Vorlia ourselves. It took everything we had
just to push it back. Dah hah hah hah!"
Yamato: "That old man's laughing about it..."
Touya: "So what's going to happen? Will it come back again?"
Rishuna: "Most likely. But Vorlia has already
appeared here once. It may be possible to summon it
without gathering all six..."
Kasumi: "Then... does that mean there's
nothing we can do...?"
Rayfon: "If there still haven't been any signs after several days,
there must be some other factor involved, don't you think?"
Touya: "...You talk like this is somebody else's problem."
Rayfon: "I'm sorry if I offended you.
But ultimately, our goal is the same as yours.
We have no intention of opposing you."
Valga: "In any case, all we can do for now
is work together to deal with it."
Arthur: "We would appreciate that as well."
Rayfon: "Then, even if it's only for a short while, I'm counting on you."
Valga: "We'll stay in your care for a while too."
Rishuna: "Thank you for having us..."
Murk: "How are things looking?"
Bernst: "There are no problems.
But I'm impressed you have all this equipment."
Murk: "This private laboratory is my pride and joy.
But don't tell the Agarthian parliament about it."
Bernst: "Of course. I understand.
If I hadn't met you, this child would have
died like he did..."
Murk: "He? You mean you have another...?"
Bernst: "Well, he was a clone.
I made a few genetic alterations, which made him unstable...
I did warn him..."
Murk: "Could that be the fellow who was said to be
pulling the strings behind the coup in the capital?
I believe his name was... Cain, wasn't it?"
Bernst: "Oh, you're well informed.
You seem to have a very capable source of information."
Assistant: "Doctooor... Aah!"
Assistant: "Owww..."
Murk: "Honestly, how many times have I told you not to run?
There's a tiny change in the floor level there."
Bernst: "...It looks perfectly flat to me..."
Murk: "Oh, pay it no mind.
This one's a little unusual."
Bernst: "Ah. A little... I see..."
Murk: "Anyway, why are you in such a hurry?"
Assistant: "Um, well, about Mr. Bernst,
the one you helped, Doctor...
It seems he's one of the ≪Ze=Ode≫."
Bernst: "..."
Murk: "By Bernst, do you mean the gentleman standing right there?"
Assistant: "Huh? ...Ah!"
Murk: "You're as scatterbrained as ever.
Well, never mind.
...So, is that true?"
Bernst: "...And what would you do if it were?"
Murk: "Hmm... It makes no difference to me.
I'm collecting valuable data this way,
and above all, I like you.
Stay as long as you wish."
Bernst: "..."
Murk: "My own research matters more. Does that put you at ease?"
Bernst: "...I see.
For better or worse, you truly are an 'Alchemical Scholar.'
Then I'll impose on your hospitality a little longer."
Murk: "Good. Oh, that's right. What happened to your Armored Mech?
If you like, I could combine it with my Baluamy technology
and modify it into something even more powerful."
Bernst: "...I'll pass."
Lodis: "...Hello. You've all come to see me."
Celica: "Lodis! Are you all right?!"
Lodis: "Yes. As you can see, it's nothing serious.
But because I was so ineffectual..."
Celica: "That's not true. Colonel Geel and the others lost their lives,
but everyone else is safe..."
Lodis: "Heh heh... Thank you..."
Arthur: "Your Highness..."
Tix: "I'm sorry, everyone. I..."
Celica: "Tix, what happened?"
Celica: "Tix?!"
Kasumi: "C-Celica... Don't be too hard on him..."
Tix: "...It's all right. I've... done something
terrible..."
Celica: "You'll tell us everything, won't you?"
Tix: "...Yes."
Celica: "...So it really was during that terrorist attack.
That's when Cain..."
Tix: "...I knew Cain was trying
to use me.
But I didn't care.
At least Cain acknowledged me.
He actually saw me..."
Celica: "Is that why you slipped out of the palace?"
Tix: "I felt like there was no place for me here...
I had nowhere else to go, but somehow I knew
where Cain was... Then I met him, and..."
Celica: "...What happened?"
Tix: "I don't remember anything after that.
When I came to, I was back at the palace.
There, Cain told me to kill Father and Lodis
and become king. But I refused...
I didn't want the throne or anything like that.
I just wanted to be acknowledged as a person.
But even Cain only saw me
as a tool...
Then Cain used some strange drug to control everyone,
and then, the coup...
I was wrong...
I don't exist just to win someone's approval.
What matters is what I can do
for other people.
But I was only thinking of myself.
When I realized that, I tried to stop Cain.
But I couldn't. If Luna, the maid, hadn't helped me,
I wouldn't be here. I escaped
thanks to her. And then, in the Chamber of Sealing, Rayfon..."
Lodis: "..."
Celica: "I see... Luna.
Thank you for helping Tix."
Maid: "Oh, no... I only did what anyone would have done."
Tix: "Luna, Lodis and Celica were all
worried about someone like me... That should have been enough, but I...
I deserve to be punished...
I deserve to stand trial."
?????: "...That's not true, Tix."
Fain: "Y-Your Majesty?!"
Celica: "Father!?"
Reginal: "Tix. There is no one who never makes mistakes.
What matters is not repeating those mistakes,
and making an effort to avoid them.
You have recognized your mistake.
Accepting punishment is easy.
But as a member of the royal family, you have your own way to atone.
Tix, let your regret feed your future actions.
What matters is not what you did in the past, but what you do from now on."
Tix: "Father..."
Lodis: "That's right. Unlike me, you're someone who
should become this country's king. You can atone
by ruling for the greater good."
Reginal: "Lodis. How long will you keep dwelling on this?
You are my son, even if we aren't related by blood.
Lodis, Celica, Tix... All three of you here
are children I am proud of."
Lodis: "Yes..."
Maki: "Oh, stop looking like that.
You're ruining that handsome face."
Rest: "...I'm sorry."
Maki: "There you go, trying to take all the blame again...
I didn't help because you asked me to.
I helped because I wanted to.
They were really fighting for the sake of this world."
Rest: "..."
Maki: "Still, failing to rescue me when I was in trouble
might disqualify you as a boyfriend. What if I ended up damaged goods
and no one would marry me?"
Rest: "...Then I would take responsibility."
Maki: "Oh, there you go again..."
Rest: "..."
Maki: "Huh...? Are you serious?"
Rest: "Am I not good enough for you after all?"
Maki: "N-No! Of course you are!
I'm happy..."
Rest: "Maki..."
Maki: "Rest... There's something
I have to tell you..."
Rest: "Hm? What is it?"
Maki: "Um... I found out when I was examined earlier,
but... well... I think I'm pregnant..."
Rest: "You think you're... what...!! D-Don't tell me?!"
Maki: "Oh, what else could I mean in this situation?"
Rest: "..."
Maki: "R-Rest...?"
Rest: "I see. A child...
Heh. You're going to be a mother."
Maki: "Hey, what's that supposed to mean?
You're going to be a dad too, you know."
Rest: "Yes, that's right.
Maki... I'm glad you're safe..."
Maki: "...Me too."
